summary: Full Capo walkthrough of MikiLab Pro Master Console. Auth: Admin Gate PIN 1985 -> capo-gate-login -> admin@mikilab.de/Mikilab2026! -> master-console loads. Overlays (kiosk auto-wizard, shift briefing) dismiss cleanly. Backend health: gate, login, /api/bako/deus/bond, /api/bako/machines, /api/floor/capo-plan, /api/weekly-plan, /api/recipes, /api/inventory all 200. Console health: all 28 HoloPanels (56 counting *-head) present, NO React ErrorBoundary text anywhere, NO purple/violet colors in panel computed styles. NEW panels verified: (1) panel-weekly renders fully with 7-day grid, weekly-add-{lun..dom}-trigger, recipe pickers, pieces/gpp inputs, live kg total, save-btn, PDF/print/share, archive; 'Add' opens rich 'Add recipes' modal with 7 categories (~150 recipes) - catalog IS populated. (2) panel-pianoai expands to 3-tab wizard (What/AI Params/Generate) with capo-generate button, weekly/today source switch, module toggles (celle, forni, clima, foodcost, turni, notte, orari, spesa, macchine, infornate, antispreco), product picker, notes. (3) panel-backward expands to Start-Time Calculator with bs-end-time, 6 duration phase inputs (rinfresco/impasto/puntata/formatura/appretto/cottura), live bs-schedule timetable computed backwards from ready time (verified: End 06:00 -> Starter 13:20), alarm toggle, defaults & reset. All render without errors. Rename regression: 'MohaLab' is displayed in hero-operatori, MIKILAB CREW roster (with 'Reparto Produzione · Fornaio'), and NO visible 'Mohamed' text in console body. Production zone Z-02: PIN 1985 unlocks MohaLab floor; capo-plan-banner present (from prior iter207 broadcast). BakoMix Deus (oven-brain): renders with bond meter 'Acquaintance · 200 XP', Make it Possible button, locked Divine Oracle, suggestions. LLM-heavy actions (master-plan ~40s, PianoAI generate ~30s, machine-recognize ~20s) were NOT re-executed here — already validated end-to-end in iter207/iter208; render + wiring confirmed.

integration_issues.issue: Three seeded weekly-plan rows have recipe_id='r1'/'r2' which do not match any real recipe UUID in /api/recipes, so each shows 'Recipe no longer available.' New adds via the 'Add recipes' modal work correctly and pick real UUIDs. Low priority — cosmetic/data-seed mismatch.

action_items: Optional low-pri: reseed initial weekly-plan sample rows with real recipe UUIDs (or clear the seed) so panel-weekly does not open with three 'Recipe no longer available' banners. Zero functional impact.
critical_code_review_comments: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — some select rendering nests a <span> inside <option>. Non-blocking (hydration warning only) but should be cleaned to avoid future SSR issues; likely a Radix/shadcn Select item template with an icon <span>.
Recharts warnings 'width(-1) height(-1)' from a collapsed chart container being measured before layout — cosmetic, no user impact.
Two /api requests returned 401 during initial pre-auth splash — expected (gate_required) but should be silenced or deferred until after gate to avoid noisy console errors.
/api/health returns 404 — no health endpoint exposed. Nice-to-have for probes.

panel-pianoai and panel-backward are NOT defaultOpen: fine, but consider making at least one of the new planning panels defaultOpen so the Capo notices them on first login. panel-weekly is already defaultOpen — good.

rca of the issue: N/A — no blockers.
